leadText: Aimi Tomita is an artist who worked as a graphic designer and Pokémon designer for the Generation III core series games. She was also a concept artist for the character designs for the movies Destiny Deoxys, Jirachi Wish Maker and Arceus and the Jewel of Life, as well as the special The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. Additionally, she made illustrations for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Aimi has illustrated cards (excluding reprints). A full list of cards illustrated by Aimi can be found here.
plainText:
Aimi Tomita is an artist who worked as a graphic designer and Pokémon designer for the Generation III core series games. She was also a concept artist for the character designs for the movies Destiny Deoxys, Jirachi Wish Maker and Arceus and the Jewel of Life, as well as the special The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. Additionally, she made illustrations for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Aimi has illustrated cards (excluding reprints). A full list of cards illustrated by Aimi can be found here.
